_comment: Native playback artifacts. packages/karadelik_mpv_libs downloads these at build time and refuses any file whose SHA-256 differs.

mirror._comment: Same files, same SHA-256: used when the upstream URL is gone. Upload new pins there too.

libmpv.source: Build scripts: https://github.com/zhongfly/mpv-winbuild (mpv-dev-lgpl). mpv and FFmpeg sources at the commits above; see THIRD_PARTY.md.
libmpv.distribution: Mirrored to the native-deps release of enesbsafak/kiptvplayer (see "mirror"); the build falls back to it when zhongfly prunes the build (30 days). A public download for end users still needs a public release location.
